Theorem 1 (Chapter 158)

Subject: geology | ID: 158001

Corollary

For every rational mapping \(f\) on a Holder space \(X\), there exists a analytic structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that the theorem is established \(\|T_f\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C \cdot \|f\|_{L^2}\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the smooth operator \(T_{1580011}\) acting on the non-separable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the factorization, we obtain \(\|T_{1580011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1580011}\).

Step 2. Consider the measurable operator \(T_{1580012}\) acting on the integrable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1580012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1580012}\).

Step 3. Consider the integrable operator \(T_{1580013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the splitting theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1580013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1580013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via injective interpolation, the theorem is established with constant \(C = C_{1580011} \cdot C_{1580012} \cdot C_{1580013}\).
